name: Divider
description: 1px horizontal rule separating content regions. Style follows the surface it sits on — default/subtle for light surfaces, knockout/inverse/subtle-inverse for dark or media surfaces.

props.name: style
props.description: Divider color for the surface context. default = standard border on light, subtle = low-emphasis on light, knockout = always-black, inverse = always-white, subtle-inverse = low-emphasis on dark.

tokenNotes: Figma binds all fills to s2a/color/divider/* variables which have not shipped in @adobecom/s2a-tokens yet — the CSS uses each variable's declared codeSyntax.WEB (border tokens) until they do.
subtle-inverse has no shipped semantic equivalent (known border/subtle-inverse gap); --s2a-color-transparent-white-16 is the exact resolved value from Figma (white @ 16%).

notes: Rendered as <hr> with role='separator' — announced as a thematic break by screen readers.
Purely decorative separators inside tightly-grouped composites may instead use aria-hidden='true' at the usage site.
